responsibility: Implements the standalone mkoffload helper for Intel MIC offloading in the x86 module. This program drives the offload-image build pipeline: it parses offload ABI options, locates the accelerator compiler, compiles and links the target image, wraps that image into a relocatable host object using objcopy and ld, creates the descriptor symbols and .gnu.offload_images section content expected by GCC’s offloading runtime, and manages temporary files and environment setup for the toolchain subprocesses.
